seo.title: Clean N Green Brand and Packaging Design | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A multi-phase identity, packaging sticker and print collateral project for Clean N Green, including a 2025 freelance brand refresh.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: My relationship with Clean N Green began while I was working at a previous organisation, where I designed the brand's original logo and supporting collateral, including its brochure, packaging stickers and visiting cards. After I moved on, the client contacted me directly in 2025 to refresh the complete visual system as a freelance engagement. That return brief expanded the work from individual assets into a coordinated identity across logo, packaging and printed applications.

sections.heading: A relationship that grew with the brand

steps.title: Building the original foundation
steps.body: The first phase established the logo and practical collateral needed to introduce the product range across packaging and sales communication.

steps.title: Returning as a freelance partner
steps.body: After I left my previous organisation, the client approached me directly in 2025 because they wanted continuity from the designer who already understood the brand.

steps.title: Refreshing the complete system
steps.body: The new engagement covered the identity, packaging stickers, visiting cards and supporting brand applications so the growing range could feel more consistent.

sections.heading: A system designed to expand
sections.body: The brochure shown here documents the earlier visual system and establishes the starting point for the 2025 refresh. The project structure can expand naturally with the updated logo, packaging stickers, visiting cards and product mockups as the complete rebrand is documented.
